description: This file defines a PHP class ControlTowerClient that extends the AwsClient class, serving as a client interface for AWS Control Tower service operations. It includes method annotations for various API actions such as creating, deleting, enabling, disabling, and listing control tower resources, both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: ControlTowerClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with AWS Control Tower, extending the generic AWS client.
